verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents several first-party background mechanisms: SQL-based monitored rules that run on a set interval and fire to reusable Slack/HTTP webhook destinations, refreshable materialized views for scheduled SQL transforms, retryable background batch jobs with pause/retry/cancel, and automated daily backups. These are specific database-level automations rather than a general automation or scheduling system, and nothing shows agents setting up or driving them autonomously. Missing for 10: a general-purpose scheduler or workflow automation feature, documented agent-initiated background automations, depth on how the scheduled pieces are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
